# SOP-P2-L4-03 First-article inspection - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-RR01, EQ-P2-L4-HT02, EQ-P2-L4-HP03

Purpose
1. Verify initial production part meets drawing and process requirements before batch release.

Preconditions
2. Verify equipment EQ-P2-L4-RR01, EQ-P2-L4-HT02, EQ-P2-L4-HP03 is available and tagged for first-article inspection.  
3. Confirm maintenance and calibration records are current per SB-1048 and that applicable line procedures have been reviewed (SOP-P2-L4-04, SOP-P2-L4-05).  
4. Ensure tooling and part traceability identifiers are present and match shop traveler.

PPE
5. Required PPE: safety glasses, heat-resistant gloves, hearing protection, steel-toe footwear, and face shield as applicable for HT operations.

Inspection steps
6. Machine setup verification
   6.1 Confirm program and recipe selection on EQ-P2-L4-HT02 match approved setup documentation.  
   6.2 Confirm mandrel and die seating on EQ-P2-L4-RR01 are clean and free of burrs.

7. Critical parameter verification
   7.1 The system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 320 bar. Verify system reads within allowed range prior to load.  
   7.2 The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is 525 N·m. Verify torque with calibrated tool and record.

8. First-article production
   8.1 Run first-article part through full heat treat and ring roll sequence under inspector observation.  
   8.2 Perform dimensional and visual checks against drawing and acceptance criteria. Record all measurements and deviations.

9. Nonconformance handling
   9.1 If any parameter or dimension is out of tolerance, stop the line, tag affected parts, and notify process engineering. Reference SB-1048 for calibration and corrective actions.

Documentation and sign-off
10. Attach completed first-article inspection report to part traveler and file per document control. Reference related procedures: SB-1048, SOP-P2-L4-04, SOP-P2-L4-05.  
11. Sign-off (Print name, role, signature, date) for: inspector, line supervisor, process engineer.
